newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank raises overnight lending to 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank raises overnight lending to 17 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank raised its overnight lending rate to 17 percent on Friday from 14.75 percent, traders said.
The adjustment was made after the monetary authority decided to raise the closely-watched overnight borrowing rate to 15 percent from 12.75 percent at midday on Thursday.
This was the second time in a month the Central Bank was forced to raise rates after the peso was rattled by Thailand's financial woes.
